patterns.message: The shared kernel’s domain contains identifiers and event plumbing, and depends on nothing else.
The shared kernel’s application layer contains the ports and faults every context shares, and depends only on the shared kernel.
The platform is technical plumbing shared by every context; it knows no bounded context.
Import other code through its alias ('@work/…', '@platform/…'): '@/…' and relative parent paths bypass every boundary rule.
The application root composes the context modules: it imports their module classes and their startup hooks, and nothing else.
